name: Procopia
anti_trude_medium: Invariant Walnut Inn-Window Casement & Linen Curtain Aperture with 9-Stratum Harvest Gouache Occlusion and 26-Lodger Inn-Room Interior

anti_trude_vector.medium: Single-frame annual return casement & step-back inn room
anti_trude_vector.mechanism: Each annual return lifts the same linen curtain on the exact same 9 autumn landscape strata while round, flat-faced, corn-eating citizens multiply (0 -> 1 -> 3 -> 6 -> 16 -> 29 -> 47 -> 144 -> 360), occluding stratum after stratum up to the upside-down trapeze of sky and filling the room behind with 26 polite lodgers.

plates_policy.rule: Genuine museum-grade map.png (1600x1200), map.svg (1600x1200), and image.png (1600x1000) are installed on disk (#560). NEVER overwrite, regenerate, or delete them. Wire and live inside ([P] toggle, [Z] loupe/tabs, [Escape] close) so complete === true and naturalWidth === 1600 (keep clean onerror guard).

canonical_stones.stone: Same room in the same inn each year; lifting the linen curtain reveals 9 invariant autumn strata.

strata_foreground_to_sky.label: Yellow Hill Hump
strata_foreground_to_sky.phrase: the yellow hump of a hill

strata_foreground_to_sky.label: Upside-Down Trapeze Sky
strata_foreground_to_sky.phrase: a patch of sky shaped like an upside-down trapeze

canonical_stones.stone: Good-natured inhabitants with round, flat faces, full cheeks, polite smiles, and ears of corn between their teeth multiply annually, progressively occluding every stratum.
invariants: At count=0 (Year I): ditchVisible === true, skyVisible === true, visibleStrataCount === 9, horizonFaceWall === false
At count=6 (Year IV): bridge and little_wall occluded
At count=16 (Year V): medlar_tree and blackberry_bushes occluded
At count=144 (Year VIII): yellow_hill occluded, only trapeze_sky remains
At count=360 (Year IX, full_saturation): skyVisible === false, horizonFaceWall === true, visibleStrataCount === 0

canonical_stones.stone: Stepping back from the curtain in the final year reveals 26 polite smiling inhabitants lodged inside the traveler's own tiny inn room, shifting knees to make space.

renderer_methods: computeLayout(width, height) -> { casement, aperture, trapezeSkyPoly, strataBands, roomZones }
